<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#210d2e">
<title>Happy Birthday, PGLLLLL LADKIIII! 🎂</title>
<style>
:root{--pink:#ff6fae;--gold:#ffd98a;--cream:#fff4e8;--ink:#210d2e}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;color:var(--cream);font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at top,#54204f 0%,#210d2e 55%,#10091b 100%);overflow-x:hidden}
main{position:relative;z-index:2;width:min(920px,92%);margin:auto;text-align:center}
.hero{min-height:100svh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:65px 12px 45px}
.eyebrow{letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);font:600 .75rem Arial,sans-serif}
h1{font-size:clamp(2.4rem,9vw,5.8rem);line-height:1.04;margin:18px 0;color:#fff0f7;text-shadow:0 0 28px #ff6fae88}
h1 span{display:block;color:var(--pink);font-size:.68em;margin-top:12px}
.subtitle{font-size:clamp(1rem,3.6vw,1.25rem);line-height:1.7;max-width:580px;color:#f8dce9}
.actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center;margin:22px 0}
button{border:1px solid #ffd98a88;border-radius:999px;padding:13px 20px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff79b4,#c43c83);color:white;font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 8px 25px #0003}
button.secondary{background:#ffffff12;color:var(--cream);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
button:active{transform:scale(.98)}
.section{padding:58px 0}
h2{font-size:clamp(1.8rem,6vw,3rem);color:var(--gold);margin:0 0 14px}
.lead{color:#f4d8e7;line-height:1.7;margin:0 auto 26px;max-width:650px}
.cake-wrap{margin:25px auto 10px;position:relative;width:210px;height:180px}
.cake{position:absolute;bottom:12px;left:25px;width:160px;height:85px;border-radius:12px 12px 20px 20px;background:linear-gradient(#ffb1c9 0 18%,#9d3b79 18% 30%,#ffdfb8 30%);box-shadow:inset 0 -9px #7d285f,0 12px 22px #0004}
.cake:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-15px;left:-4px;width:168px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff0dc;border-bottom:7px solid #ff8ebc}
.cake:after{content:"";position:absolute;top:9px;left:0;width:100%;height:18px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 18% 0,#fff0dc 0 9px,transparent 10px),radial-gradient(ellipse at 48% 0,#fff0dc 0 9px,transparent 10px),radial-gradient(ellipse at 78% 0,#fff0dc 0 9px,transparent 10px)}
.candle{position:absolute;z-index:2;bottom:95px;width:10px;height:43px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#fff 0 6px,#ff6fae 6px 12px);border-radius:3px}
.candle:nth-child(1){left:68px}.candle:nth-child(2){left:100px}.candle:nth-child(3){left:132px}
.flame{position:absolute;left:-2px;top:-19px;width:14px;height:19px;border-radius:50% 50% 45% 45%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 70%,#fff7a8 0 25%,#ff9b32 55%,#ff4e39 80%);transform-origin:50% 90%;animation:flicker .65s infinite alternate;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 9px #ffb12d)}
@keyframes flicker{from{transform:rotate(-7deg) scale(.92)}to{transform:rotate(8deg) scale(1.08)}}
.candles-out .flame{display:none}
.gallery{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;margin:28px auto 0;max-width:780px}
.photo{margin:0;padding:9px;background:#fff8f0;border-radius:15px;box-shadow:0 12px 35px #0004;transform:rotate(var(--tilt, -1deg));}
.photo:nth-child(even){--tilt:1.4deg}.photo img{display:block;width:100%;height:clamp(190px,52vw,390px);object-fit:cover;border-radius:9px}
.photo figcaption{color:#6b3152;padding:10px 3px 3px;font:italic .9rem Georgia,serif}
.note{max-width:720px;margin:24px auto 0;padding:clamp(24px,6vw,48px);border:1px solid #ffd98a66;border-radius:24px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#ffffff12,#ff6fae0b);box-shadow:0 20px 60px #0002}
.note p{font-size:clamp(1.08rem,3.5vw,1.35rem);line-height:1.95;color:#fff0f7}
.signature{color:var(--gold);font-style:italic;font-size:1.2rem}
footer{padding:20px 10px 45px;color:#d9a9c4;font: .8rem Arial,sans-serif}
.balloon{position:fixed;z-index:1;bottom:-160px;width:48px;height:62px;border-radius:50% 50% 46% 46%;opacity:.8;animation:floatUp linear infinite;pointer-events:none;box-shadow:inset -8px -5px 0 #0001}
.balloon:before{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:-7px;left:20px;border-left:5px solid transparent;border-right:5px solid transparent;border-bottom:8px solid currentColor}
.balloon:after{content:"";position:absolute;top:60px;left:24px;height:80px;border-left:1px solid #ffffff70}
@keyframes floatUp{to{transform:translateY(-125vh) rotate(12deg)}}
.sparkle{position:fixed;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;animation:twinkle 2.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate;color:#ffe5a3}
@keyframes twinkle{from{opacity:.2;transform:scale(.7)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.25)}}
.confetti{position:fixed;z-index:5;top:-12px;width:8px;height:13px;pointer-events:none;animation:fall 3.6s linear forwards}
@keyframes fall{to{transform:translateY(110vh) rotate(720deg);opacity:.2}}
@media(max-width:520px){.gallery{gap:9px}.photo{padding:6px}.photo figcaption{font-size:.78rem}.hero{padding-top:45px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*:before,*:after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}
</style>

<style>
.cake-wrap.cut .cake:after{animation:cutCake .9s ease forwards;}
.cake-wrap.cut .cake{transform:translateY(3px) rotate(-1deg);}
.cake-wrap.blown .flame{opacity:0;transform:scale(.15) translateY(8px);animation:none;}
.cake-wrap.blown .candle:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:1px;top:-14px;width:8px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #ffffff55;border-bottom:0;opacity:.65;animation:smoke 1.6s ease-out forwards;}
@keyframes cutCake{0%{clip-path:inset(0)}45%{clip-path:polygon(0 0,49% 0,49% 100%,0 100%,0 0,51% 0,51% 100%,100% 100%,100% 0)}100%{clip-path:inset(0);transform:translateX(2px) rotate(-1deg)}}
@keyframes smoke{to{transform:translateY(-18px) scale(1.4);opacity:0}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="balloon" style="left:5%;background:#ff6fae;color:#ff6fae;animation-duration:17s;animation-delay:-8s"></div>
<div class="balloon" style="left:22%;background:#ffd36f;color:#ffd36f;animation-duration:21s;animation-delay:-15s;width:38px;height:50px"></div>
<div class="balloon" style="left:74%;background:#9ee7e5;color:#9ee7e5;animation-duration:19s;animation-delay:-5s"></div>
<div class="balloon" style="left:91%;background:#bca6ff;color:#bca6ff;animation-duration:23s;animation-delay:-12s;width:42px;height:55px"></div>
<div class="sparkle" style="left:12%;top:17%">✦</div><div class="sparkle" style="left:84%;top:24%;animation-delay:.8s">✧</div><div class="sparkle" style="left:8%;top:68%;animation-delay:1.2s">✧</div><div class="sparkle" style="left:91%;top:72%;animation-delay:.4s">✦</div>
<main>
<section class="hero">
<div class="eyebrow">A little surprise, made with love</div>
<h1>Happy Birthday!<span>PGLLLLL LADKIIII 💗</span></h1>
<p class="subtitle">Aaj ka din tumhare naam — lots of smiles, beautiful memories, and all the happiness you deserve. 🎂✨</p>
<div class="cake-wrap" id="cake">
<div class="candle"><div class="flame"></div></div><div class="candle"><div class="flame"></div></div><div class="candle"><div class="flame"></div></div>
<div class="cake"></div>
</div>
<div class="actions">
<button class="secondary" id="candleBtn">🕯️ Blow out candles</button>
</div>
<p class="subtitle" id="wish" aria-live="polite">Make a wish, birthday girl! 💫</p>
</section>
<section class="section">
<h2>Our Beautiful Memories 📸</h2>
<p class="lead">Some moments deserve to be saved forever. Here are a few lovely memories. 💕</p>
<div class="gallery">
<figure class="photo"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,
